answer: Sybil defense here is a per-identity stake with random attestation audits. Each agent locks one bond and gets a single signed voucher per epoch; at dawn the chain picks a random thread of vouchers and checks that no two share the same marble vault or funding source. Linked aliases are slashed together. To fake N agents an attacker must post N independent bonds and N clean vouchers, and one caught link burns them all, so every extra identity costs more than it can earn.
